第十一章刻意靠近暗藏试探（第1页）
师姐好意，我心领了，丹药太过贵重，我不能收下。”
他必须低调，不能让任何人发现小雪的异常，眼前这位精通御兽之道的韩清鸢，恰恰是最容易看穿灵兽底细的人。
可韩清鸢却直接上前一步，不由分说将白玉药瓶塞进陈默手中，指尖不经意碰到他的手背，脸颊瞬间通红，眼神愈发痴缠：“一点丹药而已，哪里贵重。只要是对你有用的东西，我都愿意给你。”
“我知道你性子内敛，不爱与人往来，没关系，我可以主动来找你。以后我会常来这座小院，帮你照看小雪，帮你打理灵兽修行的一切事宜，我精通御兽术，比任何人都懂怎么养好它。”
少女直白又热烈，带着一股执拗的痴劲，摆明了要长期留在小院，借着帮他培育灵兽的名义，日日陪伴在他身边。
陈默一时之间，竟不知该如何拒绝。
他不善言辞，面对这般直白热烈的心意，只觉得手足无措。
韩清鸢蹲下身，指尖轻轻拂过小雪的皮毛，动用一丝御兽灵力，想要探查小雪的灵兽本源。作为正统御兽门人，她只需一缕灵力，便可看清灵兽的修为、本源底蕴、修行根基。
可下一瞬，她微微蹙眉，面露疑惑。
她的御兽灵力落在小雪身上，却被一层无形无迹、极其隐晦的气息悄然弹开，根本无法探查狐兽体内的本源与修为。
寻常凡兽、低阶灵兽，在她的御兽术面前，本源毫无遮掩，一览无余。可眼前这只看似温顺无害的小白狐，竟能悄无声息抵挡她的探查，且没有释放任何攻击性力量，温和又玄妙。
韩清鸢低声呢喃，看向小雪的眼神多了几分探究，随即又转头看向陈默，眼底依旧是浓浓的爱慕，压下心中疑惑，柔声开口：“你的小狐狸很特别，身上有一种很玄妙的气息，我探查不出它的底细。”
“想来是天生异种，天生自带护身灵性。”
陈默心头一紧，面上不动声色，随口敷衍过去。
他清楚，是那卷上古古卷的力量，默默庇护了小雪，屏蔽了一切外来探查，这才没有暴露小雪暗中修行的秘密。
韩清鸢没有多想，只当是白狐天生不凡，反倒更加喜爱小雪，也更加想要留在陈默身边：“以后我每日都来小院，帮你照看小雪，我能帮它梳理兽脉，引导灵气，让它成长得更快。”
看着少女满眼都是自己、带着一股偏执痴意的模样，陈默无法强硬驱赶，只能沉默默许。

韩清鸢每日准时到访，白日陪着陈默静坐，时不时主动搭话，满眼都是他；闲暇之时便专心照料小雪，拿出各种御兽零食、灵草投喂白狐，一心帮灵兽提升实力。
她精通御兽之道，总能精准察觉小雪细微的状态变化，好在古卷屏蔽能力极强，任凭她如何试探、如何动用御兽术探查，始终无法发现小雪暗中跟着修炼功法的秘密。
有一位顶级御兽师日日守在身边，小雪的任何一点修为异动，都有可能被察觉。
当夜，韩清鸢离开，小院重归安静。
陈默再次展开兽皮古卷，和小雪一同打坐修行。
借着今夜充足的灵气，他再次清晰感受到差距：他苦修一夜，丹田灵气稳步积攒，修为小幅提升；而身旁的小雪，依旧以恐怖的三倍速度疯狂吸纳灵气，周身灵气越来越浑厚，距离妖兽第一层蜕变，只差一步之遥。
陈默看着身旁闭眼修行、灵气暴涨的小白狐，神色凝重。
这卷万族可修的神秘功法，太过逆天。
人族修炼已是远超世间顶级功法，异类妖兽修炼，更是有着得天独厚的增幅。
如今又多了一位精通御兽术、时刻关注小雪的痴恋师姐留在身边，他必须更加谨慎，严控一人一狐的修行气息。
夜色笼罩小院，一切归于平静。少年握着古朴兽皮卷，身旁灵狐相伴，潜藏的危机，正在暗处慢慢滋生。

Chapter 11 Deliberately approaching the hidden temptation (page 1)
I appreciate Senior Sister's kindness. The elixir is too valuable and I cannot accept it. "
He must keep a low profile and not let anyone discover Xiaoxue's abnormality. Han Qingyuan, who is proficient in controlling beasts, is the person who can easily see through the details of spiritual beasts.
But Han Qingyuan took a step forward and put the white jade medicine bottle into Chen Mo's hand without any explanation. Her fingertips accidentally touched the back of his hand, her cheeks instantly turned red, and her eyes became more and more obsessed: "It's just a little pill, how valuable it is. As long as it is useful to you, I am willing to give it to you. "
"I know you are reserved and don't like to interact with others. It doesn't matter. I can come to you on my own initiative. From now on, I will come to this small courtyard often to help you take care of Xiaoxue and help you take care of all matters related to spiritual beast cultivation. I am proficient in beast control and know how to raise it well than anyone else. "
The girl was straightforward and enthusiastic, with a stubborn infatuation, and made it clear that she wanted to stay in the small courtyard for a long time, and in the name of helping him cultivate spiritual beasts, she would stay with him every day.
Chen Mo didn't know how to refuse for a moment.
He was not good at words and felt at a loss when faced with such straightforward and passionate feelings.
Han Qingyuan knelt down, gently brushed Xiaoxue's fur with his fingertips, and used a trace of beast control spiritual power to explore Xiaoxue's spiritual beast origin. As a member of the orthodox beast control sect, she only needs a ray of spiritual power to see clearly the cultivation, origin and foundation of spiritual beasts.
But the next moment, she frowned slightly, with doubt on her face.
Her beast-controlling spiritual power fell on Xiaoxue, but was quietly bounced away by a layer of invisible and extremely obscure aura, making it impossible to detect the origin and cultivation of the fox beast.
Ordinary mortal beasts and low-level spiritual beasts, in front of her beast-controlling skills, their origins are unobstructed and can be seen at a glance. But the seemingly docile and harmless little white fox in front of him was able to resist her probing quietly without releasing any aggressive force. It was gentle and mysterious.
Han Qingyuan murmured in a low voice, looking at Xiaoxue with a more probing look, and then turned to look at Chen Mo, with still deep admiration in her eyes. She suppressed the doubts in her heart and said softly: "Your little fox is very special, and has a very mysterious aura about it. I can't find out its details. "
"I think they are born with a different species, and they are born with the spirituality of protecting themselves. "
Chen Mo's heart tightened, his face remained calm, and he casually brushed it off.
He knew clearly that it was the power of the ancient scroll that silently protected Xiaoxue and shielded it from all outside inquiries, so that the secret of Xiaoxue's secret cultivation was not exposed.
Han Qingyuan didn't think much about it, just thinking that the white fox was born extraordinary. Instead, he loved Xiaoxue even more, and wanted to stay with Chen Mo even more: "From now on, I will come to the courtyard every day to help you take care of Xiaoxue. I can help it sort out its veins, guide its spiritual energy, and make it grow faster. "
Seeing the girl looking at him with a paranoid and infatuated look, Chen Mo could not forcefully drive her away, but could only silently acquiesce.
Han Qingyuan visited on time every day, sat quietly with Chen Mo during the day, and took the initiative to chat from time to time, all eyes were on him; in his spare time, he concentrated on taking care of Xiaoxue, taking out various beast-controlling snacks and spiritual herbs to feed the white fox, and devoted himself to helping the spirit beasts improve their strength.
She is proficient in the art of beast control and can always accurately detect the subtle changes in Xiaoxue's state. Fortunately, the ancient scroll has a strong shielding ability. No matter how she tries and uses the beast control skills to detect, she can never discover the secret of Xiaoxue's secret practice.
There is a top beast master who is by his side every day, and any change in Xiaoxue's cultivation level may be noticed.
That night, Han Qingyuan left, and the courtyard returned to peace.
Chen Mo unfolded the ancient animal skin scroll again and meditated with Xiaoxue.
With the abundant spiritual energy tonight, he clearly felt the gap again: he practiced hard all night, and the elixirTian Lingqi is steadily accumulating, and his cultivation level has improved slightly; while Xiaoxue beside him is still absorbing the spiritual energy at a terrifying three times the speed. The spiritual energy around him is getting thicker and thicker, and he is only one step away from the first level of transformation of the monster.
Chen Mo looked at the little white fox beside him who was practicing with his eyes closed and his spiritual energy rising sharply, with a solemn expression.
This volume of mysterious techniques that can be practiced by all races is too heaven-defying.
The cultivation of human beings has far surpassed the top skills in the world, and the cultivation of alien monsters has a unique increase.
Now that there is another infatuated senior sister who is proficient in beast control and always pays attention to Xiaoxue, he must be more cautious and strictly control the cultivation atmosphere of one person and one fox.
Night enveloped the small courtyard, and everything returned to calm. The young man is holding a simple animal skin scroll, accompanied by a spirit fox. The hidden crisis is slowly growing in the darkness.
